rationale: Luqman is building AI video generation tools for creators at Neural Studio, while Anmol's Reasoning Company works on AI inference and developer tools—complementary areas where better inference infrastructure could power more sophisticated creative applications. Both are SF-based founders working at the intersection of AI tooling, and Anmol's developer-focused approach could unlock new capabilities for the accessible creator tools Luqman is focused on.
intro_message: Luqman Elbakri, meet Anmol — you're both building AI infrastructure in San Francisco and there's potential synergy between Neural Studio's video generation work and The Reasoning Company's inference optimization.
